SELECT p.pno, name, addr, type, thumbnail, category, hit FROM place p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pno, COUNT(*) as f_count FROM favorite GROUP BY pno ) f ON p.pno = f.pno
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pno, COUNT(*) as r_count FROM review GROUP BY pno ) r ON p.pno = r.pno
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pno, COUNT(*) as l_count FROM userlike GROUP BY pno ) l ON p.pno = l.pno
category = '식당'
AND name LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%'
AND addr LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%'
ORDER BY
NVL(f.f_count, 0) DESC
NVL(l.l_count, 0) DESC
p.hit DESC
NVL(r.r_count, 0) DESC
pno DESC
pno ASC
OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 16 ROWS ONLY

SELECT CEIL(COUNT(*)/16.0) FROM place
category = '식당'
AND name LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%'
AND addr LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%'

SELECT p.pno, name, type, category, addr, phone, seat, parking, intro, hours, created_at, hit, imgs, menu, NVL(l.l_count,0) as lcount, thumbnail FROM place p
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pno, COUNT(*) as l_count FROM userlike GROUP BY pno ) l ON p.pno = l.pno
WHERE p.pno = #{pno} AND category = '식당'
